named_events.loss_description: The SPA has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 year of account. This has caused the increase in net loss ratio during the 2017 calendar year.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the SPA's gross claims outstanding were $2.536m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates modest favourable development on prior years (primarily 2015) of approximately $0.383m (a ~15.1% release relative to opening reserves). The principal cause identified in the report is exposure to major hurricanes (Harvey and Irma) which increased loss activity in 2017, but the observed prior-year movement in the triangle for 2015 is favourable. No explicit gross prior-year movement dollar statement was printed; the PYD is calculated from the gross claims development table.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) is not stated explicitly as a gross figure in narrative; PYD was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims incurred) using only the 2015 underwriting year (excluding 2016 and 2017 as per instructions). Triangle and monetary figures in the report are presented in $'000; amounts here converted to millions (native USD) but not to GBP. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross line was present. Exact_reserve_text does not state a numeric PYD.
